before: A picture command on a selected shape or text box refused with the reason 'this operation is not supported for shapes' (or textboxes).
after: The same commands refuse with the same 'unsupported' code and a reason that names the command, for example 'rotate and flip are not supported for shapes'.
reason: Only the refusal text changes, before any operation is built. No shared field, operation, node identity, snapshot, or awareness payload changes.
